// why: This package is node-only -- there is no browser half, so unlike
packages/market's project this one does not need dom in `lib`. It is kept
here anyway so the two projects stay one shape: the wiring worker adds a
`tsc --noEmit -p packages/claude-plugins` leg beside the others, and a
project that differs from its neighbours for no reason is one more thing
to re-derive on the next bump.
`checkJs` is the point of the file. The `// @ts-check` pragmas on lib/*.js
are otherwise honoured by editors only and never by CI, so a JSDoc type
could rot silently -- exactly the failure class CLAUDE.md says to pin.
Resolution reaches the staged harness through packages/claude-plugins/
node_modules, a symlink to build/harness/node_modules created beside the
stage. `npm run typecheck` therefore needs the UNPRUNED tree, because the
prune removes the very declarations this project compiles against --
AGENTS.md says the same of packages/connection and packages/settings.
